entities.summary: Alexander Aleksandrovich Chernykh is a retired Soviet ice hockey player. He won a gold medal at the 1988 Winter Olympics. He played for HC CSKA Moscow. He was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1988.
